clauses.quote: All such Teachers shall not have access to the options described in Section 4.5.5.3.
All Teachers who are separated by DCPS according to the provisions of this article shall have the right to reapply to DCPS at any time, except as otherwise required by applicable law.
clauses.subject_text: All Teachers who are separated by DCPS according to the provisions of this article

clauses.quote: If rehired, such Teachers shall be placed on the next salary step for which they would have been eligible at the time of their separation.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor granting teacher salary benefit.

clauses.quote: If rehired within one year of separation, such Teachers shall incur no break in service for pension purposes.
clauses.notes: Grammatically an obligation, but functionally grants a pension/employment continuity benefit.

clauses.quote: A Teacher’s official personnel file shall be maintained at the DCPS Office of Human Resources.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor fulfilling administrative duty.

clauses.quote: This file shall be the Teacher’s only official personnel file.
A Teacher’s official personnel file shall be treated as confidential.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor bound by confidentiality duty.

clauses.quote: Documentation of a Teacher’s performance shall be maintained in her/his official personnel file.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor fulfilling administrative duty.

clauses.quote: Anonymous material shall not be placed in a Teacher’s official personnel file.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor restricted from filing anonymous material.

clauses.quote: A Teacher shall be permitted to examine her/his own official personnel file in the presence of a DCPS Office of Human Resources representative.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor granting examination permission.

clauses.quote: A Teacher shall be permitted to obtain a copy of the material contained in her/his official personnel files pursuant to D.C. Code § 1-631.05.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor granting copy permission.

clauses.quote: A WTU representative shall be permitted to examine a Teacher’s official personnel file in the presence of a representative from the DCPS Office of Human Resources upon written authorization from the Teacher.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor granting union rep examination permission.

clauses.quote: The DCPS Office of Human Resources shall maintain a record reflecting the name and title of each person who has been granted access to a Teacher’s official personnel file.
clauses.subject_text: The DCPS Office of Human Resources

clauses.quote: Teachers shall be provided a copy of the record upon request.
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor fulfilling disclosure duty.

clauses.quote: DCPS shall keep accurate records pertaining to building and system seniority for each Teacher.

Documentation that may lead to or result in an adverse action against a Teacher shall not be placed in a Teacher’s official personnel file until a copy of such material has been provided to the Teacher.
clauses.subject_text: Documentation that may lead to or result in an adverse action against a Teacher
clauses.notes: Passive voice; implicit management actor restricted from filing adverse documentation prematurely.
